display.purpose: Page titles (2.25rem mobile, 2.75rem desktop) and the home hero (2.5rem to 3.75rem). Bricolage Grotesque with optical sizing.

title.purpose: Docs h3; footer next/previous names at 1.25rem.

lead.purpose: Description under a title, Quiet Ink, capped 52ch to 58ch.

label.purpose: Shelf cells, rail labels, table headers, tool buttons.

mono.purpose: Code, prop names, types. Inline code at 0.84em on a 7% ink plate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one blue action; paint on a pseudo-layer that scales on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; outline: 0 solid transparent; outline-offset: 0; transition: outline-width 100ms ease-out, outline-offset 100ms ease-out, color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--ds-paint, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--ds-border, transparent); transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, scale 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:active::before { scale: 0.98; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { color: oklch(1 0 0); --ds-paint: oklch(0.6 0.2 250); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { --ds-paint: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.6 0.2 250), black 5%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { --ds-paint: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.6 0.2 250), black 8%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on the page: card fill with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-o { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 10%, transparent); background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); font: 500 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, scale 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-o:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(1 0 0), black 5%); } .ds-btn-o:active { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(1 0 0), black 8%); scale: 0.98; } .ds-btn-o:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet tool: Quiet Ink label that brightens to ink on a 6% wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-g { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); font: 500 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-g:hover { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-g:active { background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-g:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shelf Trigger
components.description: Header pill naming the current page, with the four-cell cubby glyph.
components.css: .ds-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; font: 400 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-trigger:hover { background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-trigger[aria-expanded='true'] { background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); } .ds-glyph rect { fill: currentColor; opacity: 0.32; } .ds-glyph rect:first-child { fill: oklch(0.6 0.2 250); opacity: 1; } .ds-trigger-group { color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); } .ds-trigger-sep { color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 10%, transparent); } .ds-trigger-page { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); font-weight: 500; } .ds-chev { color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); transition: rotate 400ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-trigger[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-chev { rotate: 180deg; }

components.name: Cubby Shelf Index
components.description: A contents page: plain links flowing down columns; the current page takes a small blue mark.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-index { columns: 2; column-gap: 24px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-index > li { break-inside: avoid; } .ds-link { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; margin: 0 -8px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-link:hover { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-link:focus-visible { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-link[aria-current='page'] { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); font-weight: 500; } .ds-mark { flex-shrink: 0; width: 0; height: 6px; margin-right: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.6 0.2 250); scale: 0; transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), margin 300ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), scale 300ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-link[aria-current='page'] .ds-mark { width: 6px; margin-right: 8px; scale: 1; }

components.name: Preview Stage
components.description: The live component's stage: drawn with a hairline, faint light from above, tools top-right.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 16rem; margin: 0; border-radius: 18px; background-color: oklch(0.97 0 0); background-image: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 3.5%, transparent), transparent 70%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 10%, transparent); } .ds-tools { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); font: 500 12px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tool:hover { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-tool[aria-expanded='true'] { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); } .ds-canvas { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 52px 24px 40px; } .ds-demo { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.6 0.2 250); color: oklch(1 0 0); font: 500 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Tick Rail
components.description: Table of contents as ticks; expands into a floating panel with labels on hover or focus.
components.html: InstallationUsageVariantsAPI reference
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px transparent; transition: background-color 250ms ease-out, box-shadow 250ms ease-out; } .ds-rail:hover, .ds-rail:focus-within { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 10%, transparent), 0 16px 40px -12px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-rl { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 10px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: height 350ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-rail:hover .ds-rl, .ds-rail:focus-within .ds-rl { height: 26px; } .ds-rl-label { flex: 1; max-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; font: 400 13px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); opacity: 0; transition: max-width 350ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), opacity 200ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-rail:hover .ds-rl-label, .ds-rail:focus-within .ds-rl-label { max-width: 15rem; margin-right: 14px; opacity: 1; } .ds-deep .ds-rl-label { padding-left: 12px; } .ds-rl:hover .ds-rl-label, .ds-rl[data-active] .ds-rl-label { color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); } .ds-tick { flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: auto; width: 12px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 16%, transparent); transition: width 350ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1), background-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-deep .ds-tick { width: 7px; } .ds-rl[data-active] .ds-tick { width: 20px; background: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); } .ds-rl:hover .ds-tick { background: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); } .ds-rl:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: API Prop Row
components.description: Quiet hairline row: mono name, type, default, and a turning chevron.
components.css: .ds-prop { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto min-content; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 10%, transparent) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-prop:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.18 0.004 270) 2.5%, transparent); } .ds-prop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.55 0.2 250) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-prop > * { padding: 12px 16px 12px 0; } .ds-prop-name { font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: oklch(0.18 0.004 270); } .ds-prop-meta { font: 400 13px/1.4 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-prop-chev { color: oklch(0.5 0.004 270); padding: 0; transition: rotate 300ms cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1); } .ds-prop[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-prop-chev { rotate: 90deg; }

narrative.overview:
A well-made wooden shelf of labeled cubbies: everything has a place, the place is marked with a hairline and a name, and nothing is shouting. The system is quiet on purpose. Tinted near-neutrals carry the page, one blue carries meaning, and the display type carries the voice. Depth comes from a measured surface ladder rather than from decoration, and structure is ruled with hairlines rather than boxed with cards.

Density is calm and reading-first. Pages sit in one centered column with generous vertical rhythm; controls stay small, muted until touched, and brighten to full foreground on hover. Motion is a single settle curve (ease-out-expo) that opens slowly and closes quickly, and every motion collapses to a plain opacity change under reduced motion.

Light and dark are both designed. Light keeps fills neutral and lets layered shadow carry elevation; dark steps lightness up a tinted ladder and adds a lit top rim. The home page adds one ornament, the cubby mark printed as a feathered dot-matrix field behind the hero; the docs surface carries the same mark as a four-cell glyph in its shelf trigger.
keyCharacteristics: Neutrals tinted toward hue 270 at very low chroma (0.004, 0.002 near the extremes), tuned from three root variables.
One chromatic accent, the primary blue; status hues appear only on status plates.
Bricolage Grotesque (optical-size axis) for h1 to h3 and the wordmark; Geist for body and UI; Geist Mono for code.
An 8-rung surface ladder with matching shadow and rim recipes; state overlays are translucent deltas.
Hairline structure at 10% foreground; lighter 7% lines inside rows.
A near-black chrome surface, off the ladder, in both themes.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only chromatic accent outside status plates, and it means action, focus, or relation. The current location is marked in ink, never in blue; blue is reserved for what a thing is built on or what you can press.

rules.name: The Mix-Not-Pick Rule
rules.body: New tints are derived, not picked: color-mix of ink or blue into transparent at the established steps (2.5%, 3.5%, 4%, 7%, 9%, 10%, 16%, 24%, 35%, 40%). A new hard-coded gray is a defect.

rules.name: The Chrome Is Below Rule
rules.body: The chrome surface is near-black in both themes and sits off the ladder: in dark it goes below the page (0.159 against 0.205), because up is where cards live. Paint on it only through `data-surface="chrome"`, which re-points ink, muted, border, input, and hover tokens for the whole subtree.

rules.name: The Bricolage Rule
rules.body: The display face sets h1 to h3 and the wordmark, nothing smaller than about 1.05rem, and always in weight 600 with negative tracking. Body, labels, h4 and below are Geist.

rules.name: The Two-Step Ink Rule
rules.body: Headings and strong text are full ink; running prose is 88% ink. The step is small and deliberate: it lets headings lead without enlarging them.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Elevation is chosen from the ladder, never hand-written. A floating chrome surface is built from the near, mid, and far shadow alphas with no ladder ring, because rungs 3 to 8 carry their own ring.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Reading surfaces on docs (stage, note, tables, API rows, shelf grid) sit flat on the page, defined by hairlines or a faint ink wash. Shadow appears only on things that float over content: the open shelf, the expanded rail, menus.

dos: **Do** retune neutrals through `--neutral-hue` (270), `--neutral-chroma` (0.004), and `--neutral-chroma-low` (0.002) rather than editing individual grays.
**Do** take elevation from the surface ladder (`--surface-N`, `--surface-shadow-combined-N`) and state from the translucent overlays (6%, 8%, 10%).
**Do** keep blue for action, focus, and relation; mark the current location in ink.
**Do** set h1 to h3 in Bricolage Grotesque at 600 with negative tracking, and everything else in Geist.
**Do** open with ease-out-expo (`cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1)`) and close faster with ease-in-cubic (`cubic-bezier(0.55, 0.055, 0.675, 0.19)`); keep hovers at 150ms ease-out.
**Do** collapse every transform, clip, blur, and draw to opacity or nothing under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** design dark explicitly: re-declare derived tokens in `.dark` so they resolve against dark roots.
donts: **Don't** raise the chrome surface with a ladder rung or paint chrome controls by hand; use `data-surface="chrome"`.
**Don't** add a second accent hue outside status plates.
**Don't** use elastic or bouncy easing on controls.
**Don't** use neon glows, gradient meshes, or cool-AI dark-mode effects; the only gradients are the stage's 3.5% light and the feathered mask on the home dot field.
**Don't** use the reflex fonts PRODUCT.md bans (Inter, DM Sans, Plus Jakarta, Space Grotesk, Fraunces, Playfair, Cormorant, Instrument Serif, Crimson).
**Don't** box reading content in shadowed cards on docs; rule it with hairlines or a faint wash.
